parameters.name: HostId
parameters.description:
The ID of the host that you want to delete.
> You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host where the host that you want to delete resides.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host instance where the host that you want to delete resides.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
